title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 216
response_propositions: The response explains that support was urgently needed for girls' schools and for publications distributed without a profit motive, including shipments to Europe.
It interprets Purim's two gift obligations in relation to the festival's bodily and spiritual deliverance.
It presents self-sacrifice as needing to shape ordinary life by enabling the G-dly soul to direct bodily and animal drives through the intellective soul.
